description: Posts the claim's approval request in the Slack thread, in a fixed format. Refuses unless the latest check_claim result for the same unit, component, failure date and mileage was covered. Each call posts a new message.

unitNumber.description: The unit number from the check_claim result.

mileage.description: The odometer reading in miles at failure.

repairPerformed.description: The standardized description of the repair.

laborHours.description: The labor hours on the repair.

partsCost.description: The parts cost in US dollars.
